entries.approach: Ported 4 shared kernels from forge BRZA: similarity (SIMD @Vector(4,f32) cosine + scalar Jaccard), normalize (two-pass SIMD L2), entities (SIMD @Vector(16,u8) whitespace detection + FNV-1a), quantize (SIMD Q4_0 with absmax scaling). Each kernel has SIMD + scalar reference + parity tests. Fixed 'packed' reserved keyword issue in Zig 0.15.
patterns: 'packed' is a reserved keyword in Zig 0.15 — cannot use as variable name
Jaccard on sorted sets is inherently sequential (merge-join) — no SIMD benefit, delegate to scalar
For f32 SIMD, @Vector(4, f32) with @reduce(.Add) for horizontal sum is the standard pattern
Q4_0 quantization: absmax per block -> scale -> quantize to nibbles -> pack pairs into bytes
Entity extraction: SIMD finds whitespace boundaries, FNV-1a hashes each word, truncate to u32

Test buffer retry with 100-heading document (exceeds INITIAL_CAP of 64)

entries.approach: Miri arena validation: wrote 14 tests in markymark-core (no FFI deps) replicating production unsafe patterns. FakeAst/FakeIndex/FakeProperties mirror Ast/DocumentIndex/parser types. patterns: Test unsafe patterns in FFI-free crate (markymark-core) since Miri can't run C FFI (tree-sitter)
Vec<&'static str> + Box<Arena> is Miri-safe; &'static [T] + Box<Arena> triggers Box aliasing violation
Use -Zmiri-ignore-leaks when mem::forget is intentional in the pattern being tested
Separate Miri cache key in CI to avoid polluting stable build cache
